# Opensigan API

> Lightweight proxy API service for Korean school timetables (Comcigan) and NEIS meal data.

## Key Facts
- Base path: `/api/v1`
- School ID Formats (strictly separated):
  - Comcigan: `학교코드:학교명` (e.g. `2:봄빛고등학교`) -> used for `/timetable`, `/timetable.ics`, `/timetable/history`
  - NEIS: `시도교육청코드:학교코드` (e.g. `B10:1234567`) -> used for `/meals`
- JSON timetable week: YYYY-MM-DD Monday date. Backend permits ONLY current week or next week in KST (Asia/Seoul).
- Meals range: YYYY-MM-DD from/to dates, maximum 7 days inclusive.
- Calendar feed: `/api/v1/timetable.ics` supports rolling schedules (`weeks=1` or `weeks=2`), mode (`periods` or `summary`), and HTTP 304 revalidation via ETag.
- Timetable history: `/api/v1/timetable/history` accepts any Monday and returns observations retained for 30 days, not a complete historical timetable. Pass nextCursor back as cursor. Returns HTTP 503 code `history_disabled` when database is not configured.
- Configure the actual HTTP(S) API base. A public frontend deployment does not guarantee API availability. NEIS search/meals require a server-side key. Never upload allergy/profile data or log secrets. Always encode query values.

## Primary Endpoints
- GET /api/v1/status: Health check and process liveness.
- GET /api/v1/schools?q={query}: Search Comcigan schools by name (1~50 chars).
- GET /api/v1/neis/schools?q={query}: Search NEIS schools by name (1~50 chars).
- GET /api/v1/timetable?school={school_id}&week={monday_date}: Get timetable records for school and week.
  - Optional query filters: `grade` (1-6), `class` (1-99), `teacher` (case-insensitive substring).
- GET /api/v1/timetable.ics?school={school_id}&grade={grade}&class={class}: iCalendar (.ics) subscription feed.
  - Optional parameters: `weeks` (1 or 2, default 1), `mode` (periods or summary, default periods), `teacher` (case-insensitive substring, maximum 50 characters). Events are all-day; actual bell times are unavailable.
- GET /api/v1/meals?school={neis_id}&from={start_date}&to={end_date}: School meals up to 7 days inclusive.
- GET /api/v1/timetable/history?school={school_id}&week={monday_date}&cursor={optional_cursor}: Changes history.

## Error Responses
- 400 Bad Request: `{"error": "...", "code": "invalid_request"}`
- 404 Not Found: `{"error": "요청한 경로가 없습니다", "code": "not_found"}`
- 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit exceeded (60 req/min).
- 503 Service Unavailable: `{"error": "...", "code": "upstream_unavailable" | "history_disabled"}`

## Documentation
- OpenAPI 3.1 specification: /openapi.yaml
- API explorer on deployments serving it: /api-docs.html
- Repository documentation files: docs/api-guide.md and docs/client-examples.md (not API routes).
